heaviest_rainfall.status: Record amounts of rain fell over 36.8 hours today with a total accumulation of 29.53mm.  It fell at 9.4 mm per hour at times and ranked 6th from our records.  The heaviest total rainfall occurred on 09 November 2025, dropping 47.89mm of rain over the 144.8 hour storm duration with a maximum rate of 24.6mm per hour.

heaviest_rainrate.status: On 02 September 2025, the rain fell at an exceptional rate, peaking at 34.3mm per hour, the heaviest downpour recorded.  A total of 21.19mm fell over the 15.0 hour storm.

longest_rain.status: Today's rainstorm ranked 4th on our record table for the length of the storm as it lasted 36.8 hours; it delivered 29.53mm of rain at a maximum rate of 9.4mm per hour.  Rain fell for 144.8 hours on 09 November 2025 creating a new record that still lasts.  The storm produced a total of 47.89mm with a maximum intensity of 24.6mm per hour.
